images.title: What each clue means
images.purpose: Recap the three kinds of clue as a key: right digit in the right place, right digit in the wrong place, and a digit not in the code.
images.composition: Three small panels side by side across the middle, each with a three slot frame and one tile; plenty of space between panels.
exact_structure: Exactly 3 panels in a row, each with a frame of 3 empty slots in grey (#6B7280) outline.
Panel 1: a green (#009E73) tile sitting inside the first slot with a tick above it; caption right digit, right place.
Panel 2: an amber (#E69F00) tile above the first slot with a curved arrow pointing to the third slot; caption right digit, wrong place.
Panel 3: a grey (#6B7280) tile with a diagonal strike, set outside the frame; caption not in the code.
images.takeaway: Each clue either fixes a digit and its place, moves a digit, or removes it, and the final code must pass every clue.
images.description: Three panels: a green tile in place, an amber tile with an arrow to another slot, and a struck grey tile outside the frame.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Use the key to name the type of each clue before testing a code against all five.

image_decisions.why: A compact key of the clue types recaps the reasoning for checking a code.
